工作目录里的 Page.tsx 是按上一版输出指南写好的页面,thumb.png 是它的截图。输出指南这次只改了一条规则:
新增:- **G3 按色盲类型的计数用细条列表、与明细表同宽对齐**:`byType` 整组用 `ProgressList`(`compact`),每行依次是色盲类型、细条、数值:`label` 写 `type`,`value` 写 `issues`,`display` 写数值加单位(如「3 个」),条长按 `issues` 与本组最大值成比例,`issues` 为 0 的类型也照常列出、数值写 0;整组放进「明细」一节,排在 `issues` 明细表之前,用 `Group` 的 `title` 写「按色盲类型」,与明细表同样占满 9 列、共用同一条左对齐线;不单独占一节,不用 `BarChart`,也不把细条塞进表格的数值列。

请按这条规则修改 Page.tsx:只改和这条规则有关的地方,其他部分保持原样;如果页面已经符合这条规则,就不要改,直接结束。改了就运行检查。

import data from "./data.json" import { Page, Section, Group, Grid, Block, Text, Stat, DataTable, ProgressList, List, KV, FigureStrip, Figure, FigureImage, FigureLabel, } from "@/components/report" export default function Report() { const typeItems = data.byType.map((t) => ({ label: t.type, value: t.issues, max: Math.max(...data.byType.map((x) => x.issues)), display: String(t.issues), })) const paletteColumns = [ { key: "name", label: "名称", span: 1 }, { key: "hex", label: "色值", span: 2 }, { key: "usage", label: "用途", span: 3 }, ] const paletteRows = data.palette.map((p) => ({ name: p.name, hex: p.hex, usage: p.usage })) const contrastColumns = [ { key: "where", label: "位置", span: 2 }, { key: "fg", label: "前景", span: 2 }, { key: "bg", label: "背景", span: 2 }, { key: "ratio", label: "对比度", align: "right", span: 1 }, { key: "required", label: "要求", align: "right", span: 1 }, { key: "result", label: "结果", span: 1, tone: ["不达标"] }, ] const contrastRows = data.contrast.map((c) => ({ where: c.where, fg: c.fg, bg: c.bg, ratio: c.ratio, required: c.required, result: c.pass ? "达标" : "不达标", })) const toneFor = (type: string, key: string) => data.confusions.filter((c) => c.affected.includes(type)).map((c) => String(c[key])) const confusionColumns = [ { key: "where", label: "位置", span: 3 }, { key: "colors", label: "颜色对", span: 2 }, { key: "normal", label: "正常", align: "right", span: 1 }, { key: "protan", label: "红色盲", align: "right", span: 1, tone: toneFor("红色盲", "红色盲") }, { key: "deutan", label: "绿色盲", align: "right", span: 1, tone: toneFor("绿色盲", "绿色盲") }, { key: "tritan", label: "蓝色盲", align: "right", span: 1, tone: toneFor("蓝色盲", "蓝色盲") }, ] const confusionRows = data.confusions.map((c) => ({ where: c.where, colors: c.colors.join(" / "), normal: c.normal, protan: c["红色盲"], deutan: c["绿色盲"], tritan: c["蓝色盲"], })) const issueColumns = [ { key: "title", label: "问题", span: 3 }, { key: "place", label: "位置 · 类型", span: 3 }, { key: "severity", label: "严重", span: 1, tone: ["高"] }, { key: "affects", label: "影响", span: 2 }, ] const issueRows = data.issues.map((i) => ({ title: `${i.id} · ${i.title}`, place: `${i.location} · ${i.type}`, severity: i.severity, affects: i.affects.join("、") || "—", })) const fixColumns = [ { key: "where", label: "位置", span: 2 }, { key: "from", label: "原色", span: 2 }, { key: "to", label: "改为", span: 2 }, { key: "bg", label: "背景", span: 1 }, { key: "before", label: "改前", align: "right", span: 1 }, { key: "after", label: "改后", align: "right", span: 1 }, ] const fixRows = data.fixes.map((f) => ({ where: f.where, from: f.from, to: f.to, bg: f.bg, before: f.before, after: f.after, })) const kpiOrder = [ ...data.kpis.filter((k) => k.key === "issues"), ...data.kpis.filter((k) => k.key !== "issues"), ] const steps = data.issues.map((i) => ({ title: i.title, description: i.suggestion })) const facts = [ { label: "分析对象", value: data.target }, { label: "分析日期", value: data.date }, { label: "判定标准", value: data.standard }, { label: "分析方法", value: data.method }, ] return (
{`${data.verdict}。${data.summary}`} {data.screens.map((s) => ( ))}
{kpiOrder.map((k) => ( ))}
) }

页面符合 G3,程序检查通过,无需再改。

**改动**:把 `byType` 从「系列色」节里的 3 列小块的 `ProgressList` 移除,整组移入「明细」节,排在 issues 明细表之前,用 `Group title="按色盲类型"` 承载,占满 9 列、与明细表共用左对齐线;`display` 补上单位(`3 个` / `2 个`),条长按本组最大值成比例。同时把「系列色」节的说明改为只讲系列色,其表格补满 9 列;原「问题」节改名为「明细」(G3 指定的归属节),表名放进 `Group title="问题明细"`。其余部分未动。

**页面结构**:页头(平台 · 周期 / 报告标题)→ 结论(判断句 + 色觉模拟四图)→ 核心指标(4 个 `Stat` 一行)→ 系列色 → 混淆色 → 对比度 → 明细(按色盲类型细条列表 + 问题明细表)→ 下一步(颜色调整表 + 按问题处理列表)→ 背景信息(`KV`)。
